SELECT
  SPLIT_PART("email", '@', 2) AS domain,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM "customers"
WHERE "email" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY domain
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  "created_at"::DATE AS day,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM "customers"
WHERE "created_at" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', "created_at") AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM "customers"
WHERE "created_at" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
